future_check: Re-run lesson_identifiable whenever the shape sampler or sequential schedule changes.
rationale: Symmetric generated shapes allow fixed-orientation or copy-source shortcuts. Canonical symmetric shapes are still accepted by self_check, but training draws use asymmetric shapes to identify the operation.
summary: Ordinary generated shapes deliberately have four distinct H/V orientations.

future_check: Re-run task-scoped authority sync if any canonical or base-solution source changes.
rationale: Canonical program_solution and task-local raw_code/target_code are exact, whitespace-normalized, comment-normalized, and execution-parity synchronized. The defect was entirely in the generator distribution and metadata.

future_check: If the authority changes to preserve offsets, update the rule hash and replace this anchoring invariant atomically.
rationale: The Racket authority normalizes source cells before placing the reflected shape. Random translations inside quadrants would teach a translation-preserving variant that the authority does not implement.
summary: Generated shapes are bbox-normalized and anchored at each quadrant origin.

future_check: Keep a regression assertion that every normal draw has exactly three filled quadrants and every canonical input remains accepted.
rationale: Every canonical input has this occupancy. The previous one-filled/three-empty distribution taught a different problem even though the Racket rule could execute both.
summary: The ordinary distribution now has three filled quadrants and one missing quadrant.

future_check: Keep the distribution rejection test even if future oracle wrappers add validation.
rationale: Oracle executability and lesson-distribution validity are separate. self_check rejects the malformed scene, and the oracle non-crash is recorded rather than used as evidence of validity.
summary: The Racket oracle executes a mixed-color negative recombination instead of rejecting it.
